description: The EC2 instance types a spec may name. The host kind is metal when metal is true, otherwise nested. Prices are on-demand, Linux, shared tenancy, us-east-1, in USD per hour; they are assumed, not measured, and used for cost per 1,000 tasks and a campaign's cost estimates.
estimate_rule: A price marked estimated is its vCPUs times a per-vCPU rate. m8i: 0.05292 per vCPU-hour, the rate every listed m8i price works out to. c8i: the m8i rate times 0.88542, the per-vCPU ratio of c7i.metal-24xl ($4.284) to m7i.metal-24xl ($4.8384). Replace an estimate with the AWS price list before reporting a cost from it.
